sources.title: The Uttarakhand Tenancy Act, 2021
sources.publisher: Uttarakhand Urban Development Department, Government of Uttarakhand
sources.version: Act No. 02 of 2022; state-government copy listed 2025-12-29; commencement notification under section 1(3) not verified
sources.verificationNote: The official Uttarakhand Urban Development Department page lists this Act copy dated 2025-12-29. Section 1(3) makes commencement depend on a state Gazette notification; that notification has not been verified here. Do not represent current operation or applicability as established.

sources.title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019
sources.version: Act No. 35 of 2019; India Code Act ID 201935
sources.verificationNote: Act ID 201935, Act No. 35, enactment date 2019-08-09 and title matched against the official India Code record. The Department of Consumer Affairs page lists the Act and separate commencement notifications. This verifies source identity only; amendments, provision-level commencement and currentness require separate review.

sources.title: The Code on Wages, 2019
sources.version: Act No. 29 of 2019; India Code Act ID 201929; staged commencement
sources.verificationNote: Act ID 201929, Act No. 29, enactment date 2019-08-08 and title matched against the official India Code record. Gazette S.O. 5322(E) dated 2025-11-21 commences only its listed provisions; no blanket commencement date is inferred.

sources.title: Gazette notification S.O. 5322(E) — Code on Wages, 2019 commencement
sources.publisher: Gazette of India, Government of India
sources.verificationNote: Primary Gazette PDF matches identifier CG-DL-E-21112025-267885 and notification S.O. 5322(E), dated 2025-11-21. The notification specifies which Code on Wages provisions commence; it does not make every provision effective.
